category_summary: **Bot Screen / Live Desktop Passthrough Launch** — The dominant story (8+ posts). **NousResearch**'s official **[Bot Screen announcement](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-ef6b4179c4fa)** for **Hermes Desktop** — live-streaming any agent's screen/session with human take-over — was the batch's top post (~367k views), paired with **Teknium**'s companion launch of [interactive desktop passthrough for Hermes Agent](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-4784626f2a61) (~169k views, 1,094 likes). Launch support included official docs via a **[tonbistudio walkthrough](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d84a2bc0a85d)** (39k views) and **Teknium** [amplifying the guide video](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d03d44ef66a9). Sentiment was emphatically positive: replies like "[Finallllly!](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-014ad26a44c6)" and "[Much needed!](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-48968e1c836e)" (19k views) frame **Bot Screen** as a long-requested feature landing with real excitement. **oh-my-hermes & Jev ecosystem tooling** — The strongest community-builder thread: **rlaope** announced **[OMH support for Jev skills, plugins, and model routing](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-415aecf318f8)** (the most-engaged non-launch post), open-sourced **[jeval for Jev evaluation/visualization](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-8530d32deea5)**, and positioned **[OMH as an all-in-one plugin for hermes-agent users](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-b4d141253a4f)** — signaling healthy grassroots momentum. **Official Usage Tips** — **NousResearch** advised users they can [run Hermes via iMessage with any model they prefer](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-768697783517) (13k views). **Maintainer Support & Bug Triage** — **Teknium** actively triaged in public: [dismissed a reported cache issue](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d5a2f794eeec) pending a reproducible bug report, [confirmed a quick fix for a user-reported problem](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-3e1742f36c0b), and [corrected attribution that a discussed feature was built by Nous rather than Anthropic](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-992950038a21). **Community chatter** — **rlaope** called **[Opus 5.5 "crazy"](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-797e0ee6c95e)** (good) but was lukewarm on **Claude Code** — timely, given Opus 5.5's 9/22 release. Overall: a high-excitement launch week for **Hermes Desktop**, strong official-to-community amplification, and visible builder energy in the **OMH**/**Jev** ecosystem.

items.content:
You can now watch your agents work live as Hermes Desktop streams the screen of any bot's screen or session in real time. 

Watch it drive a browser, type into a terminal, or open a window. Take over anytime to interact with the Bot Screen or type credentials and seamlessly hand back off when you're done.
